title: A Phone Call to Plan Grandma's Surprise Birthday
script: Rania: [excited] Iqbal, are you free to talk? I want to plan something for Grandma's birthday next month.
Iqbal: [curious] Sure, I have a few minutes. What are you thinking?
Rania: [enthusiastic] I want to organize a surprise gathering, with all the cousins, at her house.
Iqbal: [thoughtful] That's a lovely idea. Do you think she would actually enjoy a surprise, though?
Rania: [confident] I think so. She always says she misses when the whole family was together in one room.
Iqbal: [interested] Okay, I'm in. What do you need help with first?
Rania: [organized] First, I need someone to quietly ask all the cousins if they're free that weekend.
Iqbal: [agreeing] I can message our cousins on my side of the family. That's about six people.
Rania: [grateful] Perfect, that helps a lot. I'll handle the ones on our mother's side.
Iqbal: [curious] What about food? Are we cooking, or ordering something from outside?
Rania: [thoughtful] I was thinking we cook her favorite dishes together, like she used to cook for us.
Iqbal: [warmly] She would love that, honestly. It would mean more than any restaurant food.
Rania: [curious] Can you handle getting a cake without her noticing anything unusual?
Iqbal: [smiling] Already thought of that. I'll pick it up that morning while you keep her busy at home.
Rania: [laughing] Good, because keeping secrets from Grandma is nearly impossible. She notices everything.
Iqbal: [chuckling] True, we'll need a good excuse to keep her out of the kitchen that day.
Rania: [thoughtful] Maybe I'll ask her to help me pick fabric for curtains, somewhere far from the house.
Iqbal: [approving] That could work well. She loves giving opinions about fabric and colors.
Rania: [warmly] I just want her to feel how loved she is, surrounded by everyone at once.
Iqbal: [touched] She will. Let's make some calls tonight and get this properly organized.
